name: analyze_db_health
description:
Analyzes database health. health_type is one check, a comma-separated list of them, or all (the default):
- index - invalid, duplicate, bloated and rarely used indexes
- connection - connection count and utilization
- vacuum - transaction id wraparound and dead rows
- sequence - sequences near their maximum value
- replication - lag and slots
- buffer - cache hit rates for indexes and tables
- constraint - invalid constraints

arguments.name: health_type
arguments.desc: all, buffer, connection, constraint, index, replication, sequence, vacuum, or several separated by commas.

name: analyze_locks
description: Reports the lock waits in progress: which sessions are blocked, which sessions block them, through how many hops, on which lock and for how long. Read-only diagnosis of a single snapshot: it never cancels or terminates anything.

name: analyze_query_indexes
description: Analyze a list of (up to 10) SQL queries and recommend optimal indexes

arguments.name: queries
arguments.desc: List of Query strings to analyze

name: analyze_workload_indexes
description: Analyze frequently executed queries in the database and recommend optimal indexes

name: execute_sql
description: Execute a read-only SQL query. Long cells are shortened; pass max_cell to read more. The result is also capped at 32768 bytes, whatever max_rows says; the footer says so when it is cut.

arguments.name: max_rows
arguments.desc: Maximum rows to return (default 100, at most 1000)

arguments.name: max_cell
arguments.desc: Maximum characters per cell before it is shortened (default 200, at most 10000)

name: explain_query
description: Explains the execution plan for a SQL query, showing how the database will execute it and provides detailed cost estimates. Queries with $n parameters get a generic plan.

arguments.name: analyze
arguments.desc: Runs the query and reports its real statistics instead of estimates. Slower.

arguments.name: hypothetical_indexes
arguments.desc: Indexes to simulate without creating them, e.g. [{"table":"orders","columns":["user_id","created_at"]}]. using is the index method, btree by default.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.desc: When true, returns the full PostgreSQL text plan instead of the summary.

name: get_object_details
description: Show detailed information about a database object

name: get_top_queries
description: Reports the slowest or most resource-intensive queries using data from the 'pg_stat_statements' extension. Only statements of the current database are reported.

arguments.name: sort_by
arguments.desc: resources: statements over 5% of time, I/O or WAL, by total time. total_time: total execution time. mean_time: mean time per call.

name: list_schemas
description: List all schemas in the database
